privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection
privacy.intro: Oswa Platform is committed to the highest standards of digital privacy and data ethics, adhering to the AI Ethics Charter and the Islamic Content AI Challenge standards.
privacy.section1Text: We collect only the minimal data required to operate the service and personalize your experience:
privacy.section1Item1: Display Name (optional for guests, required for accounts): Used to personalize your greeting and interface.
privacy.section1Item2: Gender & Age (completely optional): Used exclusively to personalize greetings and suggest Oswah Sprouts for users under 13. Never used for any other purpose.
privacy.section1Item3: Consultation and problem texts: Your submitted problems are processed in memory and never stored or linked to your identity by default.
privacy.section2Title: 2. What We Guarantee We Never Do
privacy.section2Item1: We never transmit personal profile data (name, gender, age) to Language Models (LLMs).
privacy.section2Item2: Your personal data is never used in search queries, vector retrieval, or situation ranking.
privacy.section2Item3: We never infer religious, ideological, political, or personal inclinations from your data.
privacy.section2Item4: We never sell, rent, or share your data with third parties or advertising brokers.
privacy.section3Text: When using Oswa as a guest without signing up, any preferences you save reside exclusively in your browser's local storage (localStorage) and are never sent to our servers.
privacy.section4Text: You can modify or delete your data anytime directly from your account page (/account), or export your complete profile as a JSON file. Deleting your account permanently deletes all related database records via Supabase cascade policies.
